mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId,o.store_id AS storeId,o.terminal_id AS terminalId, o.business_date AS businessDate,o.status,o.payment_status AS paymentStatus,o.currency, o.gross_amount_minor AS grossAmountMinor,o.discount_amount_minor AS discountAmountMinor, o.surcharge_amount_minor AS surchargeAmountMinor,o.receivable_amount_minor AS receivableAmountMinor, b.promotion_snapshot_id AS promotionSnapshotId, b.promotion_snapshot_sha256 AS promotionSnapshotSha256,p.cash_payment_id AS cashPaymentId FROM ord_sales_order o JOIN ord_promotion_binding b ON b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND b.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN ord_cash_payment p ON p.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND p.order_id=o.order_id AND p.status='SUCCEEDED' WHERE o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.order_id=#{orderId}

SELECT line_id AS lineId,sku_id AS skuId,unit_id AS unitId,quantity, gross_amount_minor AS grossAmountMinor,discount_amount_minor AS discountAmountMinor, surcharge_amount_minor AS surchargeAmountMinor,payable_amount_minor AS payableAmountMinor FROM ord_order_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY line_no,line_id
SELECT cash_payment_id AS cashPaymentId,order_id AS orderId,status,net_amount_minor AS netAmountMinor FROM ord_cash_payment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND cash_payment_id=#{cashPaymentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT cash_refund_id AS cashRefundId,refund_id AS refundId,amount_minor AS amountMinor, request_sha256 AS requestSha256,status FROM ord_cash_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND refund_id=#{refundId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor),0) FROM ord_cash_refund WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND original_cash_payment_id=#{cashPaymentId} AND status='SUCCEEDED'
